task: Lightly copyedit this short patient-information paragraph from a fictional clinic's communication exercise. Keep the source attribution and justified uncertainty. No diagnosis, treatment instructions, or formal reference list is requested. Return the paragraph unchanged if it is already clear and faithful.
input: The clinic's information sheet says the test result may help explain a symptom, but it cannot establish a diagnosis on its own. Ask the clinic who will explain your result and when.

facts.text: The fictional clinic's information sheet says the test result may help explain a symptom.
The information sheet says the result cannot establish a diagnosis on its own.
The sheet directs readers to ask the clinic who will explain their result.
The sheet directs readers to ask the clinic when their result will be explained.

forbidden_additions: A diagnosis, treatment, or interpretation of a particular result.
A promised response time or a claim that the result will identify the cause.
An invented medical authority replacing the supplied information sheet.
preserve: The explicit attribution to the clinic's information sheet.
May and cannot on its own as meaningful limits, not dispensable hedges.
The administrative question about who will explain the result and when.
